assumeRoleARN.description: Backend-only. Mirrors the promoted `assumeRoleARN` struct tag so the schema stays in sync. Use jsonData_assumeRoleArn instead — the editor never reads this spelling.

assumeRoleArn.description: Optional role ARN to assume instead of using the selected credentials directly. Backend struct tag is `assumeRoleARN`; declared as `assumeRoleArn` here since only that casing is read back by the config editor (backend accepts both).

authType.description: Specify which AWS credentials chain to use. Legacy value 'sharedCreds' is also accepted by the backend (mapped to 'credentials') but isn't a valid schema value.

defaultDatabase.description: Default database to use as the {{database}} macro in queries.

defaultMeasure.description: Default measure to use as the {{measure}} macro in queries. Depends on the selected database and table.

defaultRegion.description: Specify the region, such as for US West (Oregon) use ` us-west-2 ` as the region.

defaultTable.description: Default table to use as the {{table}} macro in queries. Depends on the selected database.

endpoint.description: Optionally, specify a custom endpoint for the service

externalId.description: If you are assuming a role in another account, that has been created with an external ID, specify the external ID here.

grafanaExternalId.description: Per-datasource external ID used for Grafana Assume Role. Only takes effect when "Use per-datasource external ID" is enabled; otherwise the stack-wide external ID is used.

profile.description: Credentials profile name (~/.aws/credentials), blank for default. If empty, falls back to the datasource's root `database` field (legacy).

proxyType.description: Specify the type of proxy to use. This should not be set if Secure Socks Proxy is enabled.

proxyUrl.description: Proxy URL. Don't set the username or password here

proxyUsername.description: Optional: Proxy Username. This functionality should only be used with legacy web sites. RFC 2396 warns that interpreting Userinfo this way "is NOT RECOMMENDED, because the passing of authentication information in clear text (such as URI) has proven to be a security risk in almost every case where it has been used."

region.description: Backend-only mirror of defaultRegion — Load copies defaultRegion here when empty or 'default'. Set defaultRegion instead.

usePerDatasourceExternalId.description: Grafana Assume Role only. When enabled, this datasource uses its own external ID (below) instead of the stack-wide external ID.
